definitions.explanation: A small to medium-sized parrot, especially species commonly kept as pets in Japan such as budgerigars and cockatiels.

examples.japanese: インコを{飼|か}っている。
うちのインコは{言葉|ことば}を{覚|おぼ}えるのが{早|はや}い。
examples.english: Our parakeet is quick at learning words.

examples.japanese: {肩|かた}に{乗|の}ったインコが{楽|たの}しそうに{歌|うた}っている。
examples.english: The parakeet perched on my shoulder is singing happily.

notes: Written in katakana as インコ; the kanji {鸚哥|いんこ} exists but is rarely used. Popular species in Japan include セキセイインコ (budgerigar) and オカメインコ (cockatiel). Distinct from オウム (larger parrots/cockatoos). Common collocations: インコを{飼|か}う (to keep a parakeet), インコが{しゃべ|しゃべ}る (a parakeet talks).
